title: Homemade Crunchwrap Supreme (Updated)
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef + your favorite taco seasoning (cover with water while cooking)
Nacho cheese (Fritos is the closest; mix mild + jalapeño)
Large tortilla, ~12 inches (Old El Paso Grande preferred)
instructions: Step 1: Beef: combine 1 lb lean ground beef with taco seasoning, cover with water, break the beef up really fine, bring to a boil, then simmer until the liquid reduces.
Step 2: Lay out a BIG (~12 inch) tortilla.
Step 3: Layer in order: seasoned beef, nacho cheese, tostada, sour cream, shredded iceberg lettuce, diced Roma tomato.
Step 4: Fold the edges toward the center, overlapping as you go, to form a classic hexagon.
Step 5: Sear folded-side down in a hot pan for 10-15 seconds to seal.
Step 6: Flip and toast the other side.
notes: From Dollar Tree Dinners Facebook reel (former Taco Bell employee's updated copycat). Recipe taken from the video caption; no exact seasoning/cheese quantities given.
